text.p: High temperatures of 90F or above will dominate much of the Plains, Midwest, and East in the USA through Friday. Across the Southwest desert regions will see temperatures near 120F in some locations. Heat-related problems are expected as a result of the widespread hot weather affecting many major cities.

Tropical Storm Danny, with 50 mph winds, is centered about 165 miles southwest of New Orleans, Louisiana, moving northeast at 5 mph. A tropical storm warning and hurricane watch is up from Cameron, Louisiana, to Orange Beach, Alabama. Danny may strengthen before landfall in the warned area. Heavy rainfall may lead to significant flooding. Danny also threatens shipping and oil rigs in the northern Gulf of Mexico.

Tropical Depression 05, with 35 mph winds, is about 475 miles east of the Windward Islands, moving west northwest at 14 mph. It may intensify into a tropical storm by tonight and may threaten the islands during the next few days.

Hurricane Felicia, with 75 mph winds, is well south southwest of southern Baja near 14.0n/118.3w, moving west northwest at 13 mph. Felicia will strengthen slightly during the next 24 hours as it maintains its current track, but it will be a threat to shipping only as it moves out to sea.
